runs.summary: 3 new recipes: Spicy Pork Rice Cakes, Pot-Roast Pheasant with Cider, Penang Chicken Laksa
runs.content:
1. Spicy Pork and Rice Cake Stir-Fry with Chilli Crunch, inspired by David Chang. A 30-minute gochujang and chilli-crunch weeknight stir-fry riffing on the Momofuku Ssam Bar rice cakes.
2. Pot-Roast Pheasant with Cider, Bacon and Celeriac, inspired by Nigel Slater. A 90-minute one-pot autumn game dish, cooked breast-down first so the lean bird stays moist.
3. Penang-Style Chicken Laksa Lemak, inspired by Anthony Bourdain. The wild card: a rich coconut-curry noodle soup from the Malaysian hawker stalls he loved, built on a fried spice paste.

runs.summary: 3 new recipes: Skillet Beef and Black Bean Chilli, Tonkatsu Curry, Smoked Haddock with Leeks
runs.content:
1. Skillet Beef and Black Bean Chilli with Quick Cornbread, inspired by Lucinda Scala Quinn. A 50-minute one-pot weeknight chilli with buttermilk cornbread for darkening October evenings.
2. Tonkatsu with Japanese Curry, Rice and Shredded Cabbage, inspired by Anthony Bourdain. Panko-crusted pork with a from-scratch roux curry, a nod to the Tokyo katsu counters he loved.
3. Smoked Haddock Baked with Leeks, Cream and Mustard, inspired by Nigel Slater. The wild card: a quiet 35-minute one-dish autumn fish supper built on sweet seasonal leeks.
